interface.title: From Snow to Reservoir
interface.field: Hydrology / cryosphere remote sensing (Georgian Greater Caucasus catchments)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and checking the quality of already-processed satellite time series and scenes (monitoring and interpretation)
interface.what_it_is_for: A Streamlit dashboard for following reservoir water area (OPERA DSWx-S1 radar) and snow and glacier area (OPERA DSWx-HLS optical) in the Enguri and Zhinvali dam catchments, through headline KPI cards, a catchment map, time-series charts and a date-stepped scene browser with the raw per-date tables.

data.note: The time series parquet files and the static layers (HydroBASINS catchment, RGI v7 glaciers, HydroRIVERS, S1 reservoir footprint, pre-rendered scene PNGs) ship with the app. Enguri: catchment 3139 km², 63 S1 and 56 HLS valid scenes, 05.08.2024–19.10.2026. Zhinvali: catchment 2089 km², 64 S1 and 54 HLS valid scenes, 23.08.2024–14.10.2026. Basemap tiles (Esri satellite, Stadia dark and terrain) did not load because the app is offline, so the maps show vector and overlay layers on a grey background. Switching basemaps still changes the attribution line.

children.general: Find dates where a measurement was withheld because too little of the area was observed
children.specific: In the Water (DSWx-S1) table, water_km2 = None on dates caught by the S1 coverage gate: catchment valid_px_pct under 90% (about 59% for Enguri, about 85% for Zhinvali) while the reservoir is at least 95% observed, so reservoir_area_km2 is kept and only water_km2 is blanked. This is why the AOI-total line ends early. A separate reservoir guard (under 95% of the lake observed) blanks both values; no such date was seen in this run

screens_never_reached: Basemap imagery (Esri satellite, Stadia dark, Stadia/Stamen terrain): the tiles never loaded because the app runs offline. Only the attribution line changed (screens/008.webp, screens/073.webp)

Any visual marking of cloud gaps or coverage-gated dates on the charts themselves: the charts simply draw straight lines across gaps (screens/033.webp), and the blanked water_km2 values are only visible as None cells in the raw table
not_done: Download as CSV from the raw-data tables: I clicked it twice and no file was saved, while the Plotly PNG download did save (newplot.png). The CSV export may use a save dialog the headless browser does not handle

The sidebar Time range does not narrow the Scene Browser Date slider: it still ran 05.08.2024–10.10.2026 after I narrowed the range (screens/060.webp). The Time range does narrow the KPI ranges and the charts
The valid-scene counts on the Overview did not change when I narrowed the Time range (64 S1 · 54 HLS in screens/016.webp and screens/018.webp)
Legend clicks on the Plotly chart were slow and unreliable: two clicks sometimes cancelled each other out, so I left the AOI total trace hidden
The Scene Browser shows no per-scene caption with cloud cover or valid-pixel %. Quality can only be judged from the raw table, not next to the image
Clicking the reservoir label on the Overview map gave no popup or selection, so the map does not feed a selection to any other panel
The Streamlit Main menu and Deploy buttons are framework chrome, not part of the app, so I did not explore them
